item.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
item.description: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
item.description: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

item.description: President Trump has a big week on the international stage, from the United Nations General Assembly to hosting the Chinese president at the White House.

item.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
item.description: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

item.title: In Colorado, a GOP candidate says his differences with Trump show he's with the voters
item.description: We look at Republican Congressman Jeff Hurd's campaign in Colorado, where he is using his breaks with President Trump as an asset in his bid for reelection.

item.title: Politics chat: Trump announces a Greenland deal, bans more media from the White House
item.description: We look at President Trump's announced ban of some media outlets covering the White House, as well as what a big cash windfall might mean for Republicans in the coming midterm elections.

item.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
item.description: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.

item.title: SpaceX has big plans for a new Louisiana 'Star Base,' worrying some near there

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
item.description: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."
